W03-DA04-S005-resources-1.failure_scenario: With PostgreSQL statement_timeout and lock_timeout both disabled, an uncommitted transaction holds an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on twitch_stream_sessions. N concurrent authorised streamer-list requests, where N equals pool_max, acquire all dashboard connections and wait indefinitely. Subsequent dashboard requests requiring the same pool fail their acquisition deadline, while the original requests remain blocked until the transaction releases its lock.

W03-DA04-S005-resources-1.expected_behavior: A stalled database operation should have a finite execution deadline so it cannot retain every shared connection indefinitely. W03-DA04-S005-resources-1.countermeasures: Admin authentication limits who can trigger these queries. Pool size and acquire_timeout bound connections and later acquisition waits, but do not terminate already executing SQL.
